title: A member with 2 GiB has its agent killed by the kernel during npm install
foundBy: session agent, while reading the member trajectories of a `make demo` run

evidence.verified: The check was `sudo dmesg | grep -c "Out of memory"`, run inside each member. Before the change it returned 1 on the developer and 1 on qa. In the two runs after it, it returned 0 on all three members, and each member reported 3902 MiB in total.

details:
The profile gave each member 2048 MiB. The opencode server and its attached run hold about 1 GiB between them. An `npm install` or a Vite server on top of that ended with the kernel killing the agent.

Nothing reported it. `cs-campaign observe` still showed `node-working` with no continuations. The member sat idle for about five minutes until `wait` prodded it, and a new session redid the work. The stall was taken for a slow model. It happened to the developer and to qa in the same run.

To check a member that stalls, run `sudo dmesg | grep "Out of memory"` inside it.

notes.text: This is filed upstream in the campaign repository's ledger as SAC-030: a member whose agent the kernel killed still reads as `node-working`. The 4096 MiB here removes the cause, and the silence is campaign's to fix.
